snippet.title: RoboMaze 2: The Lobby gameplay (PC Game, 1991)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for RoboMaze 2: The Lobby, Dos PC game produced by Wetware in 1991 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/robomaze-2-the-lobby/8103/
RoboMaze 2 is a pretty nice game based on more adventure and puzzle style. In this game you're a robot and you have to pass different levels thrilling.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
